title: maprounea gracilis
intro: Maprounea gracilis, commonly known as African maple, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
